author: saving money
text: We used Bragg Waste Services for a portable toilet rental, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The unit was delivered and set up right on time, extremely clean, and well-maintained. Pickup was just as smooth, and the service was professional and reliable throughout. Highly recommend them if you need portable restroom services—you won’t be disappointed!

author: McGuires Enterprises
text:
I highly recommend Bragg Waste Services. We used them for a port-a-john and
hand washing station rental for a party. The equipment and hand washing stand were clean and in excellent condition. Our delivery driver was prompt and courteous. The timing for delivery and pickup were exactly as we were told. Great  service!

author: Tracy Jolly
text: I was very pleased with the Portal Potty. It was clean when it arrived, they also put sanitizer in the bowl and it smelled great! They arrived on time and picked up in a timely. I highly recommend Bragg Waste Services and I will definitely use them again if needed in the future!!

author: NotYourAverageBear
text:
Extremely concerning driving by one of your large waste service trucks today around 4:20 PM on Charlotte Highway in Fairview NC. The driver was traveling at a very high speed and following other vehicles far too closely, driving aggressively and recklessly around multiple other drivers.

Driving a large commercial truck this way is incredibly dangerous and puts everyone else on the road at serious risk. This kind of behavior could easily result in a serious accident or someone losing their life.

Please take this incident seriously, investigate the driver, and ensure that anyone operating your company’s vehicles is driving safely and responsibly. A large truck like this has no business being driven so recklessly.

author: Don D. Lewis
text: Kevin Bragg was prompt and very friendly. He did a great job and answered my questions pertaining to my septic system. I highly recommend his company.
